column1: # One tissue/disease term per row, resolving to each layer's own key. Curated, not derived:
# every rE2G/PCAWG pairing is a judgment (a cell line is not a tumour cohort) — see `note`.
# The plain tissue word keeps the *tissue* biosample rE2G has (so an enhancer-only question
# about "liver" means liver, as it always did); the disease words map to the cancer cell line.
# Both rows carry the same PCAWG codes. aliases: `;`-separated words a question may use.
# re2g: ENCODE biosample ontology id (the byCohort key). pcawg: `,`-separated ICGC project
# codes (the SV cohort unit). Empty = the layer has nothing comparable; the host says so.
